title: Perplexity rolls out Teammates, an always-on AI agent system that integrates with Computer to handle multiple roles and execute large-scale tasks simultaneously (Emma Roth/The Verge)
summary: Emma Roth / The Verge: Perplexity rolls out Teammates, an always-on AI agent system that integrates with Computer to handle multiple roles and execute large-scale tasks simultaneously — Like OpenAI's Dots and Claude Duet, Perplexity's Teammates can perform an array of tasks while running 24/7.
